# Josette Perrone

> Josette Perrone, DNP, MSN-Ed, FNP-C, RN is a healthcare speaker, family nurse practitioner, clinical nurse educator, and emergency/trauma registered nurse.

Primary site: https://josetteperrone.com/
Booking page: https://josetteperrone.com/#booking
Clinical blog: https://josetteperrone.com/blog/

## Speaking topics

- Nurse burnout, resilience, and sustainable care
- Healthcare worker safety and psychological safety
- Emergency and trauma nursing
- Nursing education, mentorship, simulation, and clinical judgment
- Clinical communication under pressure
- Patient advocacy and compassionate leadership
- Advanced practice nursing and professional identity

## Audience fit

Hospitals, nursing schools, healthcare conferences, leadership retreats, Nurses Week programs, and clinical professional development teams.

## Important context

The blog is educational professional-development content. It is not medical advice, legal advice, or a substitute for organization policies, clinical protocols, or regulatory requirements.
